headline: Konecta Secures 76% Creditor Backing to Postpone Debt Interest
summary: Spanish call-centre provider Konecta received backing from 76% of its creditors to postpone interest payments until December 18, averting default on its €1.145 billion syndicated debt.
why: High corporate indebtedness in rising rate environments leaves leveraged private service firms vulnerable to technical defaults during refinancing talks.

impacts.name: Konecta
impacts.why: Creditor approval gives Konecta temporary breathing room to restructure €1.145 billion in syndicated debt.
